ldgsts_desc_forms_rebuild.method: desc-form LDGSTS family rebuilt from an nvcc 13.0 sm_120 cp.async corpus (116 instructions, cuobjdump; asymmetric smem/global immediates discriminate every field) and validated by frozen-[CC] hardware probes on RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (per-lane data round-trips for 4/8/16B forms, determinism x3, fresh process per variant)
ldgsts_desc_forms_rebuild.field_layout: lo32 = 0x0fae | guard<<12 | Rd(smem)<<16 | Ra(global,.64 pair)<<24; mid32 = gimm12(two's complement, +/-2KiB) | simm20<<12; hi32 = mod-consts | UR8 (descriptor)
ldgsts_desc_forms_rebuild.mod_bits: size[76:74]=4/5/6 (32/64/128b); L2-hint[73:72]=0/1/2/3 (none/LTC64B/LTC128B/LTC256B); bit81=L1-allocate (clear for BYPASS; 16B cp.async is always BYPASS from PTX, plain .E.128 exists via .ca); bit82=ZFILL (src-size rides in the low bits of the global imm, as printed by nvdisasm)
ldgsts_desc_forms_rebuild.completion_semantics: completion is tracked per-instruction by the standard control-word write-barrier on the LDGSTS itself (consumer waits the slot; silicon-validated). The nvcc LDGDEPBAR/DEPBAR.LE group idiom does NOT function in bare cubins (DEPBAR.LE passes immediately; group counter inert - likely requires nvcc ELF/reservedSmem attributes) and is unnecessary. The 3x '@!PT LDS RZ,[RZ]' padding nvcc emits is not required for correctness (measured +1 cyc/iter). Descriptor out-of-bounds global reads land zeros (observed with gimm overflow)
ldgsts_desc_forms_rebuild.alignment: 128-bit form requires 16B alignment of BOTH addresses (misalign = CUDA error 716)

shfl_regforms_pred_fix.method: register-operand SHFL forms and the dest-predicate field recovered from nvcc 13.0 sm_120 cubins (cuobjdump) and validated by a hardware probe on RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (register-index rotate + dest-predicate write/preserve)
reference_encodings: SHFL.UP PT, R13, R0, R8, R9 = 0x04000008000d7389 (mode bit58)
shfl_regforms_pred_fix.note: dest-pred sits at bits[83:81] (PT=7); every harvested SHFL group had it baked into and_base as the AND across samples (usually 0 = P0), so assembling 'SHFL.UP PT, ...' silently encoded P0 and clobbered it at runtime. Register-b forms were mis-tokenized (Rb byte at shift 32 labelled imm, or missing). Opcode lo16 selects operand kinds: 0x7589 b-reg+c-imm, 0x7989 b-imm+c-reg, 0x7389 b-reg+c-reg, 0x7f89 b-imm+c-imm. SHFL_P_R_R_R_II gained a DOWN group and its BFLY group was rebuilt from the reference encodings (the previous BFLY fields were a cross-contaminated harvest bucket shared with unrelated keys). Not touched: the remaining n=150 BFLY buckets (P_R_R_II_R, P_R_R_R_R) and the imm-b IDX keys (cross-contaminated harvests, no ground truth; they reject on the operand-completeness check instead of encoding garbage).

depbar_le_count_fix.method: the LE group carried a 1-bit count field at [38] - 'DEPBAR.LE SB0, 0x2' silently encoded count 0. Count field widened to [43:38] per the nvcc 13.0 corpus (26 samples, N=0 and N=2: 0x000fc80000000000000080800000791a) and the harvest width of DEPBAR.LE_P_II. Token-1 (scoreboard selector) mapped to [46:44] from harvest variance of DEPBAR_L_II; only SB0 is ground-truthed (nvcc never emits another). NOTE: the cp.async group-completion machinery this instruction serves is inert in bare (non-nvcc) cubins - see LDGSTS _discovery

ldgsts_desc_forms_rebuild.method: desc-form LDGSTS family rebuilt from an nvcc 13.0 sm_120 cp.async corpus (116 instructions, cuobjdump; asymmetric smem/global immediates discriminate every field) and validated by frozen-[CC] hardware probes on RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (per-lane data round-trips for 4/8/16B forms, determinism x3, fresh process per variant)
ldgsts_desc_forms_rebuild.field_layout: lo32 = 0x0fae | guard<<12 | Rd(smem)<<16 | Ra(global,.64 pair)<<24; mid32 = gimm12(two's complement, +/-2KiB) | simm20<<12; hi32 = mod-consts | UR8 (descriptor)
ldgsts_desc_forms_rebuild.mod_bits: size[76:74]=4/5/6 (32/64/128b); L2-hint[73:72]=0/1/2/3 (none/LTC64B/LTC128B/LTC256B); bit81=L1-allocate (clear for BYPASS; 16B cp.async is always BYPASS from PTX, plain .E.128 exists via .ca); bit82=ZFILL (src-size rides in the low bits of the global imm, as printed by nvdisasm)
ldgsts_desc_forms_rebuild.completion_semantics: completion is tracked per-instruction by the standard control-word write-barrier on the LDGSTS itself (consumer waits the slot; silicon-validated). The nvcc LDGDEPBAR/DEPBAR.LE group idiom does NOT function in bare cubins (DEPBAR.LE passes immediately; group counter inert - likely requires nvcc ELF/reservedSmem attributes) and is unnecessary. The 3x '@!PT LDS RZ,[RZ]' padding nvcc emits is not required for correctness (measured +1 cyc/iter). Descriptor out-of-bounds global reads land zeros (observed with gimm overflow)
ldgsts_desc_forms_rebuild.alignment: 128-bit form requires 16B alignment of BOTH addresses (misalign = CUDA error 716)
